headline: This law adds March 29, National Vietnam War Veterans Day, to the list of days when the American flag should especially be displayed.
what_it_does: The law adds National Vietnam War Veterans Day, March 29, to the list of days when the flag should be displayed with special emphasis. It is a recognition measure and does not create new programs, payments, or required actions for individuals or agencies.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on March 28, 2017.
